sources.title: GitHub - Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy4-preview
sources.snippet: We provide AngelSlim, a more accessible, comprehensive, and efficient toolkit for large model compression. AngelSlim supports a comprehensive suite of compression tools for large-scale multimodal models, including common quantization algorithms, low-bit quantization, and speculative sampling.
